name: schedule_pickup
description:
Schedule an in-person pickup for a marketplace item. Creates a commitment that is immediately visible to the buyer. Times are in the time zone of the seller's account region.
[Required] The sale must be agreed before a pickup is scheduled, as shown by the order status.
[Notice] The buyer sees the time and location immediately.

time.description: One moment, not a range, with a time zone offset. The seller states it, or sets a range that a pickup request from the buyer must fall inside

location.description: Where the seller and the buyer meet, as the seller names it

buyer_contact.description: How the buyer is reached. Read from the platform, not from what anyone says
